project.name: Jadal
project.tagline: Canal water shared by volume, not by hours.
project.summary: Rotational canal water allocation transformed from fixed hours (warabandi) to deterministic volume accounting with FAO-56 crop physics, bilingual Telugu voice agents, and double-entry ledger verification.

creative.direction: Quiet premium civic-infrastructure launch film; serious, clear, evidence-based; no startup sarcasm.
creative.hookPrompt: On this canal, everyone received their hours — and the tail still lost her crop. Hours are not water.
creative.outroPrompt: LLMs propose · Core computes · Coordinator approves. Fair water, verified by ledger.

narrative.heroClaim: Canal water shared by volume, not by hours.

voiceLine.telugu: నాకు ఈ వారం అత్యవసరంగా నీరు కావాలి.
voiceLine.english: I urgently need water this week.

narrative.shareCopy: Jadal replaces fixed-hour canal rosters with volume-based sharing: crop physics converts volume into turn time, Telugu voice calls reach every farmer, and a double-entry ledger guarantees conservation.

source.heroMetric: Tail need-met equal-hours (~42%) vs equal-water (>90%), Gini drops from 0.31 to 0.05

sections.title: Hours are not water
sections.keyMetric: Outlet 8 tail flow drops by 29.4% due to seepage over 3 km

sections.title: Need in: registration + entitlements
sections.keyMetric: FAO-56 model calculates gross volume per crop, stage, and soil

sections.title: Coordinator approves: roster + requests
sections.keyMetric: Tail need-met rises from ~42% to >90%; Gini improves from 0.31 to 0.05

sections.title: Telugu voice request + acknowledged calls
sections.keyMetric: Voice-first telephony for farmers without smartphones (f5, f8)

sections.title: Ledger proof + event replay
sections.keyMetric: Conservation holds: supply = quotas + buffer + delivered + losses
